raw_comment:
I notice that the regions with extreme drought are near mountainous regions, like the rocky mountains and the Appalachian mountains.  Suggesting that the more mountainous or near mountainous the area is, results in more drought.

I wonder why there are certain specific regions with extreme droughts, specifically near the south, northwest and mid-Atlantic region.  I also wonder if the areas of drought change location depending on the month of the year, as the image only shows the level of drought for the last week of October, 2024.

This relates to me and my community because we can all be affected by droughts.  Hence, being well versed in the location of droughts is beneficial. 

“Droughts from the North to the South, Droughts from the East to the West!”
